## Gates run

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:dist`
- [ ] `npm test` (full deterministic suite) — for non-trivial changes

## How this lands

Development happens in a private repository; the maintainer hand-ports accepted
changes upstream and they arrive in the next release export. Your PR may be
**closed as landed with credit** rather than merged directly — that's the
normal path, not a rejection. See CONTRIBUTING.md. This is a solo-maintained
hobby project: reviews happen as time permits.
